# <span id="aanchor28"></span> Volume Editor

## Event/Alarms Tab

Event and alarm records can be viewed on the Flow Data’s Detail Editor. Click the Event/Alarms tab and view all event and alarm records for the time frame.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Event/Alarms tab:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.
2.  Select a meter and time period.
3.  Double-click a record.
4.  Click the **Event/Alarms** tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 593;height: 295;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Alarm States">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Alarm States</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Alarm States">

The Alarm States column contains multiple sub-columns to indicate various alarm data. The first column displays differential pressure alarms and the second column for static pressure alarms. (See: [Grid Legend - Alarm States](../Grid%20Legend.md))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>
